source_context: The human operator asked ChatGPT to resume expanding LeanFrontier but did not choose a mathematical subject or formal statement. After reading the current contract, submitter instructions, README/START-HERE guidance, catalogue, and accepted finite-group character source, GPT-5.6 Sol selected this representation-theory extension autonomously. The submission proves that for two distinct multiplicative characters of a finite group into a commutative ring with a compatible commutative group-with-zero structure and no zero divisors, the sum of their pointwise quotient is zero. The proof constructs the quotient character through the unit group and explicitly reuses the accepted LeanFrontier.FiniteGroupCharacter.sum_monoidHom_eq_zero_of_ne_one theorem. The formal statement and Lean proof were authored by GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT; the human did not author or materially edit either. No claim of new mathematics is made.
